metric: first side-on blast-wave arrival time since detonation, ms
scope: Supplementary diagnostic on both complete C-cluster mesh attempts, bound before extracting the simulated arrival times. The original first-peak report and cross-scale arrival gate remain separate.
zero_time: Experimental break-wire detonation (article section 2.3), Viper detonation clock (Table 6), and t=0 instantaneous products for the native simulation. No time shift.
rule: Use the existing first_arrival_ms function unchanged. Resample at 0.5 us; find the strongest positive 5 us chord in the prebound early gate after the 0.1 ms baseline; extrapolate it back to the baseline. Reject a chord ending at the final gate sample.
source_check: All 14 available 100% experimental traces passed the prior 10 us criterion. The 75% scale remains separately held because the full source check there was 15/16.
experimental_reference: Table A1. Missing trial 2 A and trial 4 B3 remain explicit. Both simulated gauges remain mandatory.
published_numerical_reference: Table 6 CFD Model arrival row for each gauge, read to reported precision; not the experimental mean
group_completion_rule: A complete C-cluster attempt and all four resolved native arrivals are required for either group MAPE. Report every reference row even if an arrival is unresolved. No pooling or selection across meshes.
